newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- CCB Financial rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- CCB Financial rating cut.

text.p: - Chicago Corp said it cut its rating of CCB Financial Corp, a bank holding company, to hold from buy, based solely on valuation.

- Chicago Corp previously maintained that CCB Financial was undervalued in relation to its peers. The company said the price has appreciated over the last month to the point where it now trades slightly above its peers.
- In the long run, CCB Financial remains one of the most attractive acquisition candidates in our universe, Chicago Corp said.
- CCB Financial shares were down 1-5/8 to 68.
